assessment.nobel_worthiness: Defines GLP-1 as an incretin hormone and its physiology, and underpins therapies that have transformed type 2 diabetes and obesity care and now show cardiovascular and renal benefit. Originality, clarity and breadth of impact are exceptional for a combined physiology-to-medicine story.
assessment.attribution: Holst (physiology and secretion of GLP-1 in humans), Drucker (biology of GLP-1 and GLP-2 and receptor signalling) and Mojsov (peptide chemistry and identification of the active truncated form) are the most defensible trio. Knudsen's liraglutide/semaglutide development is major but industrial; other early contributors such as Habener are not in the supplied credit, which limits a fair configuration.
assessment.maturity: Mature: decades of mechanistic work and large randomized outcome trials, with broad real-world use. Recognition is timely and arguably pressing.
uncertainties: Priority dispute, especially Mojsov versus other groups on the discovery of active GLP-1(7-36), is not resolved by the supplied text.
Whether the committee wishes to recognize the drug development (Knudsen) rather than the basic discovery is open.
My recollection of the detailed history is not independently verified.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Engineering patient T cells with chimeric antigen receptors created a new therapeutic modality producing durable remissions in refractory B-cell malignancies; conceptually original and clinically transformative.
assessment.attribution: June (clinical translation, 4-1BB costimulation in CD19 CAR-T) and Sadelain (CD28-costimulated CAR design and preclinical foundation) are strong; Rosenberg's adoptive cell therapy and TIL work is foundational but a distinct line, and early CAR concept originators such as Eshhar are not in the supplied credit.
assessment.maturity: Several approved products and long follow-up establish clinical efficacy; durability, toxicity and extension to solid tumours remain evolving, but the core discovery is confirmed.
uncertainties: Allocation among CAR design, costimulation and adoptive-cell-therapy lines is contested.
Absence of credited early originators weakens the fairness of any two or three person configuration.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Light-gated control of defined cell types in intact circuits has transformed experimental neuroscience and given causal tests of circuit function; the tool is original and its lasting impact is very large, though it is a method more than a disease mechanism.
assessment.attribution: Nagel and Hegemann (with Bamberg) identified and characterized channelrhodopsins; Deisseroth and Boyden (with Miesenböck's earlier genetic photostimulation) made neuronal optogenetics work. Three-person limit forces difficult exclusions of Bamberg, Boyden and Miesenböck.
assessment.maturity: Mature as a research tool with 20 years of independent use; clinical translation is early (retinal vision restoration), which is acceptable for a method prize.
uncertainties: Exclusion of at least three credited contributors is unavoidable and contentious.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Rational splice-modulating antisense therapy (nusinersen) turned the most common fatal genetic infant disease into a treatable one; an elegant mechanistic discovery followed by decisive clinical benefit.
assessment.attribution: Krainer (SMN2 splicing mechanism and ASO design logic) and Bennett (antisense chemistry and development at Ionis) form a clean two-person configuration; clinical-trial and academic collaborators, and others in antisense chemistry, may be argued.
assessment.maturity: Approved since 2016 with long-term outcomes and demonstrated class generalization; timely.
uncertainties: Whether the committee considers it a cohesive discovery or part of a broader antisense/oligonucleotide field is open.
Contributions of other SMN gene discoverers are outside this candidate's credited names.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: L1 virus-like particle vaccines prevent persistent HPV infection and cervical neoplasia; population data show large reductions in cervical precancer and cancer. Cancer prevention by vaccination is an outstanding medical achievement.
assessment.attribution: Lowy and Schiller (VLP assembly and immunogenicity) and Frazer (co-development of VLP vaccine technology) are well supported; others working in parallel (e.g., Zhou, Kirnbauer) are not included in the supplied credit and priority is shared.
assessment.maturity: Highly mature with extensive confirmation in real-world effectiveness over more than 15 years. Recognition is timely, although zur Hausen's HPV discovery was already honoured in 2008.
uncertainties: Parallel invention by several groups complicates fair attribution.
Overlap with an earlier HPV-related prize may reduce appetite.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The unfolded protein response revealed how the endoplasmic reticulum communicates stress to the nucleus, a fundamental cell-biological principle linked to diabetes, neurodegeneration and cancer.
assessment.attribution: Walter and Mori independently delineated the IRE1/HAC1/XBP1 signalling axis and the mechanism of the response; a two-person configuration is natural, although other contributors such as Ron or Kaufman exist outside the supplied credit.
assessment.maturity: Very mature, with decades of independent confirmation; therapeutic translation (ISRIB, IRE1 and PERK modulators) is still developing.
uncertainties: Direct disease-treatment impact is not yet established.
Omission of other UPR contributors could be disputed.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Showed that TNF drives inflammation in rheumatoid arthritis and that blockade is effective, establishing biologic therapy for autoimmune disease with huge clinical effect.
assessment.attribution: Feldmann and Maini jointly led the mechanistic and clinical proof of concept; a clean two-person credit, though antibody and TNF cloning contributions by others (and Kollias, Vilcek) may be argued.
assessment.maturity: Fully mature with approved agents for decades; recognition is somewhat late rather than premature.
uncertainties: Industrial antibody engineering and other TNF discoverers may complicate credit.
Competition from more recent prize-worthy candidates.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Discovery of orexin/hypocretin and its loss in narcolepsy established the molecular basis of a sleep-wake disorder and led to orexin antagonists for insomnia; a clean bench-to-bedside physiology story.
assessment.attribution: Sakurai and Yanagisawa discovered orexins and receptors; de Lecea and Kilduff independently identified hypocretin; Mignot's canine narcolepsy genetics and human findings connected the system to disease. Credit among five names is difficult to limit to three.
assessment.maturity: Well confirmed across species and by approved orexin antagonists; narcolepsy autoimmune mechanism remains partly open.
uncertainties: Simultaneous independent discovery leaves priority contested.
Exact roles of the disease-link contributions are from memory and unverified.
